actions.reason: K5_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coordinated OXPHOS/mitochondrial down-regulation with TGF-beta/WNT up-regulation), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Its own set-level alignment shows near-zero silhouettes (RNA 0.058, WXS 0.053, CT 0.006, WSI -0.003) and within-versus-between distances differing only marginally, indicating little geometric support for treating this membership as a separate unit. Pair-level boundary evidence against its neighbors is similarly weak: the K5_C0001-K5_C0002 boundary silhouette is essentially zero (0.00042) with between-set affinity only marginally below within-set, the K5_C0001-K5_C0004 boundary silhouette is essentially zero (0.00063), and the K5_C0001-K5_C0005 boundary is represented only in WSI (0.393) while CT/RNA/WXS are near zero. No positive membership-independence basis survives, so the current unit is not retained.

K5_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulated OXPHOS/metabolic program, NES up to ~2.85; VHL/PBRM1 depletion at the mutation level), but identity does not establish independent membership. Its set-level alignment is only weakly positive (WXS 0.173, CT 0.047, WSI 0.027, RNA 0.008), and its pair boundaries are weak or modality-specific: the K5_C0001-K5_C0002 boundary silhouette is essentially zero (0.00042) with between-set affinity only marginally below within-set, and the K5_C0002-K5_C0004 boundary is represented only in WXS (0.291) while CT/RNA/WSI are essentially null. The union of K5_C0001 and K5_C0002 screens at a single-cluster resolution, which is not evidence against merge but also provides no positive boundary support. No positive membership-independence basis survives, so the current unit is not retained.

K5_C0003 has an interpretable biological identity: a strongly up-regulated immune/inflammatory program (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3; NES up to ~2.78) with immune-dominated leading-edge genes, and a distinctive mutation profile dominated by strong BAP1 enrichment (OR 23.1; q_driver 7.5e-5, q_global 0.018), the only driver-panel result surviving both within-panel and family-wide adjustment. Unlike the other candidates, its membership is positively supported by consistent, modest within-versus-between separation across all four modalities (silhouettes WSI 0.117, CT 0.066, RNA 0.063, WXS 0.052) with within-set distances smaller than between-set in every modality, and its boundary with K5_C0005 is consistently expressed across modalities (silhouettes RNA 0.145, WXS 0.139, WSI 0.075, CT 0.064). This is the only candidate with cross-modal membership and boundary support, so it is retained for downstream stability aggregation.

K5_C0004 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulated EMT/stromal-angiogenesis program with OXPHOS down-regulation), but identity does not establish independent membership. Its set-level alignment shows essentially no within-versus-between distinction (WXS 0.073, RNA 0.001, WSI -0.006, CT -0.032) with within-set distances equal to or larger than between-set in most modalities. Its pair boundaries are weak or modality-specific: the K5_C0001-K5_C0004 boundary silhouette is essentially zero (0.00063) with between-set affinity only marginally below within-set, and the K5_C0002-K5_C0004 boundary is represented only in WXS (0.291) while CT/RNA/WSI are essentially null. No positive membership-independence basis survives, so the current unit is not retained.

K5_C0005 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulated E2F/MYC/G2M proliferation program with interferon down-regulation), but identity does not establish independent membership, and its estimates rest on only 4 patients. Its set-level alignment is modality-specific: WSI shows separation (0.268) while CT (0.002), RNA (-0.0003), and WXS (-0.040) are null or negative. Its boundary with K5_C0001 is likewise represented only in WSI (0.393) with CT/RNA/WXS near zero, and its boundary with K5_C0003, while consistent, is modest and rests on only 21 patients. The separation signal is confined to a single modality and the membership is unstable, so no positive cross-modal membership-independence basis survives and the current unit is not retained.
